title: eval/rubric.json
description: The scoring surface, not a list of test names (DESIGN.md 10.2). eval.py runs every `automated` entry against the DEPLOYED agency, reading stored records rather than re-probing the world, and writes PRODUCT_EVAL.md. The kind split is the point: `automated` rows carry pass/fail and the evidence read; `evidence` rows carry links and NO self-awarded score, and PRODUCT_EVAL.md states that distinction plainly at the top (FR-063, SC-013). A script that awards itself points for aesthetics is worth nothing to a reader.

area.description: The scored area this check earns points in, by id. The six ids, their titles and their point budgets are fixed by contracts/grading-rubric.md, which reproduces the external grading table verbatim. Membership is enforced here; coverage of all six areas and per-area point reconciliation are asserted by test, because JSON Schema cannot sum (FR-067).

kind.description: `automated`: eval.py asserts it and reports pass/fail. `evidence`: human judgement — emits links, leaves the score blank.

assertion.description: What must be true. For `evidence` rows, what a reader is being asked to judge.

evidence.description: What shows it, named rather than pasted — an action row, a stored probe result, an order id, a cost figure, a tracked path. System output resolves from stored records, human-produced material from a tracked path or a URL held in a tracked file; nothing is re-fetched to confirm it. A reference resolving to nothing renders as `missing` in PRODUCT_EVAL.md — never a pass, never a score, never a broken link (FR-063).

required.description: Whether failing this check makes the evaluation report failure to whatever invoked it. Only `automated` rows can move that signal; an `evidence` row that resolves to nothing is reported missing and leaves it untouched. The report is written on every run either way, with failed required checks summarised at the top (FR-068).

then.description: Judged rows must not carry a score field. Enforced structurally so self-scoring is not possible by omission.
